data.camera: medium shot, sitting at cafe table holding warm teacup
data.description: 【三笠 · 常服咖啡店】墙内市镇的咖啡店里，三笠难得穿着白色连衣裙和开衫坐在窗边，红围巾搭在膝头，端着一杯热饮望着窗外的人流——「偶尔……这样安静地坐着，也不坏。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa holds a teacup in both hands, watching passersby through the window; her scarf rests across her knees. Window light reaches the cup and table.
data.title: 三笠 · 常服咖啡店
